attchmntText: Veto Switchgears And Cables Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Veto Switchgears and Cables Limited has published the extract of its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended September 30th, 2026, in the Business Standard and Mumbai Lakshadweep editions dated 07th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results during its meeting held on 06.11.2026. The company filed this notice with BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange Limited in compliance with SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulation 2015. The document also contains unrelated advertisements for NCC training camps and Project Management Consultant appointments for various housing societies in Mumbai.

attchmntText: Veto Switchgears And Cables Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
